history.value: Goal 2 runs on this engine only (play and training). Arena ladder: level 0 our gauntlet against an outside-designed fixed chooser; level 1 a stated headless Act-1 setting on our engine with a map, common relics, potions and Ascension knobs (parity caveat); level 2 the real game through a mod bridge, waits for the owner's StS1 install. A half-day level-0 parity harness (sts_lightspeed, parity only) is allowed. 'Dominant' is written down once level 1 has relics, potions, a map and the ~40 missing Ironclad cards; no number in the field's unit is claimed before.
